supplemental_items.interpretation: Point selection evaluates inclusive source start/end first, then inclusive decision end; a failed source test skips the decision check and serialization. Visible cycle collection retains encounter order for cycles with an MBL and trigger no later than visible end; formed leg selection is separately delegated through end, requires a confirmed primary point, and does not clip source to visible start. MBL identity offsets reference and second indexes only in the id. Cap uses the actual full-history candle at source+400 if strictly below candle count, otherwise last candle timestamp plus timeframe times (source+400+1-count); no visible-end clamp. Trigger and confirmation main times and exact event times are separately sourced. Each stop field independently tests non-null stop index then <= end; zero and equality survive. Non-null cycle id adds transformed cycleId. Output legs retain generator order.
